The five artists with the most albums in the database are:

- Iron Maiden — 21 albums
- Led Zeppelin — 14 albums
- Deep Purple — 11 albums
- Metallica — 10 albums
- U2 — 10 albums

Note: Metallica and U2 are tied with 10 albums each (a tie at the 4th/5th positions). The next artist after these has 6 albums (Ozzy Osbourne).
